title: REC-C3.3.1 — identity + storage seam (ExecutionLogProvider port lifted)
summary: SessionExecutionLog consumes Arc<dyn ExecutionLogProvider>. New port ExecutionLogProvider (object-safe, session-scoped) with seven methods (session_id, append, record_gap, read_from_seq, retained_from, tail_seq, tail_state, seal). Two adapters in chronos-log (Segmented + InMemory). Domain lifts ExecutionKind/ExecutionPayload/TripwireFiredEvidence + NewExecutionRecord/Gap/GapReason/TailState/SealedTail/ExecutionRecord + EventSeq + SessionId to single-owner. ProviderKind enum gates maintenance capabilities (flush, compaction_metrics, maybe_compact, compact_up_to, retain_up_to) on the wrapper, not on the port. legacy_segmented_backend_for_native_bridge is the only narrow concrete escape (C33-DEBT-NATIVE-LOG-BRIDGE-01), allowed in session_log.rs and probe.rs only. record_gap is canonical-evidence, port-lifted. map_log_error removed from events_log_read and projection (ratchet advance). Composition root placement: chronos-mcp::composition.

scope_decisions: Field inversion first, construction inversion later. C3.3.1 closes the seam (SessionExecutionLog holds Arc<dyn ExecutionLogProvider>); the composition-root inversion is C3.3.2, NOT C3.3.1.

Maintenance capabilities (flush, compaction_metrics, maybe_compact, compact_up_to, retain_up_to) stay on the wrapper, gated by ProviderKind. They are NOT on the port; the port stays minimal and object-safe.
record_gap is canonical-evidence, lives on the port (commit 5ca9aeb6). No legacy gap path on the port.
legacy_segmented_backend_for_native_bridge is the only narrow concrete-backend escape hatch (C33-DEBT-NATIVE-LOG-BRIDGE-01), allowed in session_log.rs and probe.rs only.
map_log_error removed from events_log_read.rs and projection.rs (ratchet advance). map_execution_log_error is the canonical-evidence path.
Composition root placement: chronos-mcp::composition, NOT chronos_services::composition (per operator and ADR-0015 D4).
smoke_subset: e2e_connectivity + analytics_tools + program_scenarios. Rationale: this cycle adds/modifies the storage port, the SessionExecutionLog field, and the gap record path; analytics_tools exercises record_gap + read_from_seq end-to-end through the MCP server, program_scenarios exercises probe lifecycle which is the only consumer of legacy_segmented_backend_for_native_bridge, and e2e_connectivity confirms the server starts at all.
